aiExecutionPolicy.providerCallLimit: Transition attempts are the enforceable runner limit; underlying provider calls may be multiple. Capture observed provider usage and do not label this an API-call limit.
aiExecutionPolicy.usageGate: After the first12 canary transitions, calculate measured tokens and cost for the remaining cohort and set a recorded token/cost budget before scaling AI. If usage cannot be measured, stop AI scale-up while continuing verified deterministic data work.
aiExecutionPolicy.bulkSafety: Population transitions contain no AI rules. The executor dispatches AI only for recorded cohort identities. Do not use disabled rules or mocked effects to manufacture status distribution.

configurationCounting: One project-specific workflow with13 attached rule instances (4 premade validators,1 AI validator,7 static post-functions,1 semantic post-function),1 project-scoped listener and1 project-scoped job per project. Knowledge/settings are reported separately and excluded from runnable configurations. Each workflow derives from one of four families; families are not additional workflows.
